name: stage-rollup
why: A stage with children ignores its own duration (30 here) and spans its children. Hidden Start(S) and Finish(S) nodes are never returned. The stage is not counted in the status: its span comes from its children.

s.why: es = min child es 0; ef = max child ef 5; ls = min child ls (0, 1, 3) = 0; lf = max child lf (3, 5, 5) = 5; tf = least child float 0; ff = free float of Finish(S), which has no successor: PF 5 - 5 = 0.

c1.why: Start(S) has ES 0, so c1 starts at 0. LF = min(PF 5, c3: LS 3, Finish(S): 5) = 3. FF = min(c3: 3 - 3, Finish(S): 5 - 3) = 0.

c2.why: Only successor is Finish(S): LF = LF of Finish(S) 5; FF = ES of Finish(S) 5 - 4 = 1.

c3.why: FS from c1: 3. LF 5 from Finish(S).
